question: 跟2026年一季报相比，二季报前十大有什么换仓动作？新进了谁、又剔出了谁？
first_sql: SELECT SEC_NAME AS `证券简称`, COMB_SYMBOL AS `证券代码`, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN REPORT_DATE = '2026-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '新进' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN REPORT_DATE = '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '剔除' END AS `换仓动作` FROM FUND_PORTFOLIO_DETAIL WHERE FUND_NAME LIKE '%大成高新技术产业股票A%' AND REPORT_DATE IN ('2026-03-31', '2026-06-30') AND FUND_HOLDING_SOURCE_ID = 1 AND HISVALID = 1 GROUP BY SEC_NAME, COMB_SYMBOL HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN REPORT_DATE = '2026-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 OR MAX(CASE WHEN REPORT_DATE = '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
